pipeline_params.description: Dalpha LLM Router -- routes each query across a 4-model pool (gemini-3.8-flash at thinking_level=low, gemma-4-31b-it, claude-haiku-5.5, deepseek-v4-pro with thinking off) using a zero-shot query classifier and a per-task routing table calibrated on external data only (public source benchmarks, items disjoint from RouterArena). No RouterArena data was used to build or tune the router.
